text:
Jae L: Ruben emailed that his EAD card was lost in mail. He has a receipt notice from USCIS (I-797C). Wants to know next steps for payroll and I-9 reverify.
Kavita S: sorry to hear that. First, ask Ruben to upload the I-797C receipt and passport page to /hr-onboarding. We'll need to start a Form I-765 duplicate filing (replace EAD).
Ruben M: uploaded receipt now. timeline? can I still work while replacement is pending?
Immigration Legal: yes — if he has a receipt notice for a timely-filed I-765 replacement (filed before expiry) and the previous EAD was valid at time of filing, he can present the receipt + passport for Form I-9. However lost card means we need to do I-9 reverification once replacement arrives.
Kavita S: Payroll Bot, can you keep payroll active based on receipt docs?
Payroll Bot: action required. We can provision payroll as long as HR attaches the I-797C and a copy of passport. Mark employee status "active - pending EAD replacement". Background check/benefits unaffected.
Jae L: do we need to request an expedite with USCIS? Ruben, any urgent travel or personal hardship?
Ruben M: yes, I have a family emergency next month — may need to travel. Would expedite help with receiving a physical card?
Immigration Legal: expedite criteria are narrow but we can request: severe financial loss, urgent humanitarian reasons, or emergent travel. Provide supporting docs if you want us to try. Note: receipt doesn't guarantee faster card issuance.
Kavita S: Checklist for Ruben to upload ASAP:
- I-797C receipt (PDF)
- Passport biopage (PDF)
- Signed statement about lost card and mailing address
- Any travel docs if requesting expedite
Payroll Bot: Reminder: once replacement EAD arrives, HR must update I-9 Section 3 (or reverify in Section 3) and attach scanned card to file.
Ruben M: uploading docs now. Thanks all. If expedite fails, can I use the receipt to re-enter US?
Immigration Legal: Receipt may allow re-entry on some carriers but it's risky. We'll advise getting travel authorization from CBP/consulate before booking.
Kavita S: follow-ups: @Immigration Legal to draft expedite packet if Ruben provides docs; @Payroll Bot will hold payroll active; @Jae L to coordinate I-9 reverify appointment when card arrives.
Jae L: noted. Ruben, DM me when you uploaded the statement so I can attach to your HR file. :thumbsup:
__nofield_note: All values are strings or list of strings as required.
